## About

I am a PhD candidate in Sociology at Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile.  
My research focuses on **household wealth, economic security, and educational trajectories**, with an emphasis on how asset–debt configurations shape unequal futures.

## Research agenda

- Wealth as configuration (assets + liabilities, liquidity, collateralizability)  
- Economic security as a temporal capacity (shock absorption and planning)  
- Educational trajectories under unequal financial infrastructures

## Current projects

- *Household Wealth Configurations and the Unequal Security of Family Futures in Chile*  
- Wealth reconstruction using survey data and machine learning  
- Economic hardship and age profiles (EBS 2023)
